originalTitle: Pinterest shares fall on lukewarm sales guidance
summary: Pinterest reported better-than-expected earnings and revenue for the second quarter, though its forecast was online in line with estimates.
content:
Pinterest shares fell 7% in extended trading on Tuesday after the company reported better-than-expected earnings and revenue but issued lukewarm sales guidance.

Here's how the company did, compared to analysts' consensus estimates from LSEG:

Sales rose 18% from $998.2 million a year earlier, while the company's net loss for the period was $47 million, a loss of 8 cents per share, Pinterest said in a statement. The social media company posted net income of $38.76 million, or 6 cents per share, a year ago.

"Our Q2 results reflect the scale and strength of our platform," Pinterest CEO Bill Ready said in the release.

Revenue this quarter should come in between $1.19 billion and $1.21 billion. The midpoint of $1.2 billion was in line with analyst expectations. The guidance "assumes a modest headwind from foreign exchange based on current spot rates," Pinterest said.

Pinterest finance chief Julia Donnelly told analysts during an earnings call that the World Cup ending and Amazon 's Prime Day moving to the second quarter impacted brand spending and thus third-quarter guidance. "The shift of Prime Day from Q3 last year into Q2 this year resulted in an approximately half-point benefit to Q2 and will represent a roughly half-point headwind to Q3 as multiple brands and retailers increase their advertising spend around that moment," Donnelly said. "Lastly, in Q2, we saw a nearly one-point benefit from World Cup-related spend that will not repeat in Q3."

Adjusted earnings for the quarter of $311 million, topped analyst projections of $270 million, according to StreetAccount.

The company's global monthly active users, or MAUs, jumped 11% year-over-year to 640 million, beating estimates of 635 million.

Global average revenue per user, or ARPU, was $1.86, ahead of projections.

During the earnings call, Ready also discussed Pinterest's use of freely available, so-called open-weight artificial intelligence models , a topic of rising interest in corporate board rooms as companies increasingly focus on AI's high costs .

"At this point, any CEO that's not taking advantage of open source models is almost certainly wasting a lot of their shareholders' money," Ready said. "And especially that's true now that you have hyperscalers making it really easy to take advantage of that open source in their their secure environment, so that you can leverage the open source in your own cloud environment, so that it's safe, it's secure." As Pinterest continues using a mixture of both proprietary and open-weight AI models, Donnelly explained to analysts how the company manages AI-related costs using "model routing infrastructure." This lets Pinterest use "higher-cost models for complex work while using lighter, lower-cost options for routine tasks," she said. Still, Donnelly noted that "As AI adoption continues to grow, we expect both AI-related compute and token spend to grow over time."

"We see that these investments are ROI positive, and that investment growth is planned and included in our outlook that we've provided," Donnelly said.

chineseTitle: Pinterest 股价因销售指引不温不火而下跌
chineseSummary: Pinterest 公布的第二季度盈利和收入好于预期，但其在线预测与预期一致。
chineseContent:
Pinterest 股价周二在盘后交易中下跌 7%，此前该公司报告了好于预期的盈利和收入，但发布了冷淡的销售指引。

与伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 分析师的一致预期相比，该公司的表现如下：

Pinterest 在一份声明中表示，销售额较上年同期的 9.982 亿美元增长了 18%，而该公司当期净亏损为 4700 万美元，每股亏损 8 美分。这家社交媒体公司一年前公布的净利润为 3876 万美元，即每股 6 美分。

Pinterest 首席执行官 Bill Ready 在新闻稿中表示：“我们第二季度的业绩反映了我们平台的规模和实力。”

本季度收入应在 11.9 亿美元至 12.1 亿美元之间。 12 亿美元的中值符合分析师预期。 Pinterest 表示，该指引“假设根据当前即期汇率，外汇将出现温和的阻力”。

Pinterest 财务主管 Julia Donnelly 在财报电话会议上告诉分析师，世界杯的结束和亚马逊 Prime Day 推迟到第二季度影响了品牌支出，从而影响了第三季度的指导。唐纳利表示：“黄金日从去年第三季度转移到今年第二季度，给第二季度带来了大约半个百分点的收益，并且随着多个品牌和零售商在那一刻增加了广告支出，也将代表第三季度大约半个百分点的逆风。” “最后，在第二季度，我们看到世界杯相关支出几乎增加了一个百分点，而第三季度不会再出现这种情况。”

据 StreetAccount 称，该季度调整后收益为 3.11 亿美元，高于分析师预测的 2.7 亿美元。

该公司的全球月度活跃用户 (MAU) 同比增长 11%，达到 6.4 亿，超出了 6.35 亿的预期。

全球每用户平均收入 (ARPU) 为 1.86 美元，超出预期。

在财报电话会议上，Ready 还讨论了 Pinterest 对免费提供的所谓开放权重人工智能模型的使用，随着公司越来越关注人工智能的高成本，公司董事会对这个话题越来越感兴趣。

“在这一点上，任何不利用开源模式的首席执行官几乎肯定会浪费股东的大量资金，”雷迪说。 “尤其是现在，您拥有超大规模企业，可以非常轻松地在其安全环境中利用开源，这样您就可以在自己的云环境中利用开源，因此它是安全的。”随着 Pinterest 继续混合使用专有和开放权重人工智能模型，唐纳利向分析师解释了该公司如何使用“模型路由基础设施”来管理人工智能相关成本。她说，这让 Pinterest 可以“使用成本较高的模型来处理复杂的工作，同时使用更轻、成本较低的选项来处理日常任务”。尽管如此，唐纳利指出，“随着人工智能采用的不断增长，我们预计与人工智能相关的计算和代币支出都会随着时间的推移而增长。”

唐纳利说：“我们看到这些投资的投资回报率为正，投资增长是有计划的，并包含在我们提供的前景中。”
